intent: Keep security-sensitive DB01 global settings typed and non-public; distinguish deployment-host/cookie configuration from optionally persisted, narrowly constrained OTP/identity policy. Source default matching is not behavior acceptance.
sourceDecisions: All seven values are GLOBAL-only in active AppSettingsService getters; legacy superadmin generic overrides exist, so replacing editable values with deploy-only values requires explicit UX/API redesign consent.
HOST/cookie settings stay deployment-managed by default; a persisted cookie Domain or SameSite mutation could disrupt existing sessions and cookie isolation across hosts.

Three numeric controls may use a one-row typed global DB policy after Chat 1 migration approval. Defaults are legacy-matched; proposed bounds strengthen security, not literal legacy acceptance of arbitrary integers.
Existing identity_auth_attempts.verification_attempts check caps attempts at 5. Runtime limit must be min(configured maxAttempts, 5), applied in a single conditional UPDATE, not a read-then-write.
No key may be emitted by general client-settings. Public tenant-bootstrap host metadata requires an explicit allowlist and public origin/host checks, never a generic dump.
Do not build unrestricted app_setting clones, module_access_rules pseudo-module rows, or per-tenant OTP policy as incidental DB01 parity.
SQL staged proposal and source tests are not registered migrations, executed PostgreSQL, API/identity-provider proof or signed retirement decisions.
